name: Amulet of Inescapable Location
description: Appears to prevent magical location and detection, but instead imposes a -10 penalty on saves against divination spells.

name: Armor of Arrow Attraction
description: Appears and functions as +3 full plate in melee, but imposes a -15 AC penalty against ranged weapon attacks.

name: Armor of Rage
description: Functions as +1 full plate, but gives its wearer -4 Charisma and grants unfriendly creatures within 300 feet +1 morale on attacks against the wearer.

name: Bag of Devouring
description: Appears to be a bag of holding, but is an extradimensional creature's feeding orifice. It can seize and consume creatures reaching inside and may swallow stored contents into another plane.

name: Boots of Dancing
description: Appear to be beneficial magic boots, but subject the wearer to irresistible dance during or while fleeing melee. Remove curse is required once revealed.

name: Bracers of Defenselessness
description: Appear and function as bracers of armor +5 until a worthy enemy attacks, after which they impose a -5 AC penalty and require remove curse to take off.

name: Broom of Animated Attack
description: Appears to be a broom of flying, but dumps its rider and attacks with four +5 attacks per round; its straw blinds and its handle deals 1d6 damage.

name: Cloak of Poisonousness
description: Kills a wearer who fails a DC 28 Fortitude save when donned. It requires remove curse to take off, after which neutralize poison permits revival magic.

name: Crystal Hypnosis Ball
description: Appears to be a crystal ball, but fascinates its user and implants telepathic suggestions from a remote controller. It is an uncreatable minor artifact.

name: Dust of Sneezing and Choking
description: Appears to be dust of appearance. Creatures in its 20-foot spread risk 2d6 Constitution damage, another 1d6 one minute later, and are stunned for 5d4 rounds even on a successful save.

name: Flask of Curses
description: When first opened, creatures within 30 feet must make a DC 17 Will save or take -2 on attacks, saves, and skill checks until remove curse is cast.

name: Gauntlets of Fumbling
description: Appear beneficial until danger activates the curse, after which the wearer loses 2 Dexterity and has a 50% chance each round to drop anything held.

name: Helm of Opposite Alignment
description: On a failed DC 15 Will save, permanently changes the wearer's alignment to a radically opposed one. Only wish or miracle restores the former alignment.

name: Incense of Obsession
description: Appears to be incense of meditation, but makes a divine spellcaster obsessively confident and determined to expend every available spell within 24 hours.

name: Mace of Blood
description: A +3 heavy mace whose bonus fades unless coated in blood daily. Its possessor must make a DC 13 Will save each day or become chaotic evil.

name: Medallion of Thought Projection
description: Appears to read thoughts but supplies misleading figments while broadcasting the user's own thoughts to creatures in the targeted area.

name: Necklace of Strangulation
description: Constrains immediately when worn, dealing 6 damage per round. It cannot be removed short of limited wish, wish, or miracle and remains attached after death.

name: Net of Snaring
description: A +3 net that functions only underwater and can be commanded to shoot up to 30 feet to trap a creature.

name: Periapt of Foul Rotting
description: After 24 hours in a creature's possession, permanently drains 1 Dexterity, Constitution, and Charisma each week until a prescribed sequence of curative magic is completed.

name: Potion of Poison
description: A corrupted potion that forces a DC 16 Fortitude save against 1d10 Constitution damage, repeated one minute later.

name: Robe of Powerlessness
description: Imposes -10 Strength and Intelligence while worn. Removing it is easy, but remove curse followed by heal is required to restore the victim.

name: Robe of Vermin
description: Appears protective, but in combat imposes -5 initiative and -2 on attacks, saves, and skill checks; spellcasting also requires a concentration check.

name: Ring of Clumsiness
description: Functions as a ring of feather falling but also imposes -4 Dexterity and 20% arcane spell failure for spells with somatic components.

name: Scarab of Death
description: Animates into a burrowing beetle after being held or carried, killing its victim unless a DC 25 Reflex save tears it away first for 3d6 damage.

name: Spear, Cursed Backbiter
description: A +2 shortspear that strikes its wielder on a natural 1 in melee and deals double its normal damage back to the wielder when the curse triggers on a throw.

name: Stone of Weight (Loadstone)
description: Halves its possessor's base land speed and magically returns if discarded or destroyed until remove curse is cast.

name: -2 Sword, Cursed
description: A longsword that imposes -2 on attacks and damage in combat and, after one week, compels its owner to use it. Only limited wish, wish, or miracle disposes of it.

name: Sword, Berserking
description: Appears to be a +2 greatsword, but drives its wielder berserk in battle, forcing attacks against the nearest creature until no living target remains nearby.

name: Vacuous Grimoire
description: Reading even one word forces two DC 15 Will saves against 1 permanent Intelligence drain and 2 permanent Wisdom drain. It must be burned while remove curse is cast to destroy it.
